name: Docker socket group, in the image
description: Adds the remote user to the docker socket's group at image build, so every process from init onwards holds it and there is no moment to get wrong.

gid.description: The gid of the host's docker socket. 0 under OrbStack and Docker Desktop, where it is root-owned; a native Linux host owns it by a docker group and passes that gid instead.

username.description: The user the session runs as.
